description: The CONTOUR Forward Imager (CFI) was one of the two CCD cameras on CONTOUR, intended for coma studies and approach imaging. Its 10-position filter wheel held nine narrow spectral filters (5–15 nm wide, centred from 309 to 920 nm; the narrowest are UV filters for coma emission features) and one broadband clear filter.
facility_description: CONTOUR (Comet Nucleus Tour) was a NASA mission to study the diversity of comet nuclei. The ground-calibration documents for its two CCD imagers are archived at the PDS Small Bodies Node.
notes: Researched 2026-10-26. CONTOUR ground-calibration data are archived in the PDS Small Bodies Node (CON-CAL-ALL-6-DOC-SET-V1.0); the NASA science data licence page states there are no restrictions on usage. Instrument: Conard et al. (2004). Bandpasses are documented in Izenberg (2002), "Bandpasses for spectral filters of CONTOUR imagers". Bands with suffix _fil are the Barr laboratory filter transmissions; base band names are relative responses from monochromator scans through the instrument during APL calibration. Suffix oob marks the scans of the narrow-band filters repeated with out-of-band rejection filters in the light path. Manager review: detector details not found in the linked pages were removed; DetectorType is unchanged.
